# OGTV, in full

> OGTV is a free TV-style app for India: 47 always-on channels built from official YouTube uploads, from live news, cricket and the Olympics to Bollywood, bhajans, KBC, Taarak Mehta and documentaries, in Hindi and English. Open it and something is already playing. https://ogtv.co.in/ · A shorter version: https://ogtv.co.in/llms.txt

OGTV opens on Latest Mix, the last two days' trending videos from every channel, Sports first. Every channel below opens playing at its own address. Times are India Standard Time, for Thursday, 26 November.

## Pages for each need

- [Free TV for India, online](https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-tv/): OGTV is free TV for India: 47 always-on channels in Hindi and English, from live news and cricket to Bollywood, bhajans and family shows. No sign-up.
- [Radio for India, free and non-stop](https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-radio/): OGTV's Radio mode is free radio for India: Bollywood, old Hindi songs, Punjabi, bhajans and live news, non-stop, and on Android with the screen off in Brave.
- [News for India, live and in one place](https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-news/): Free news for India on OGTV: live news 24x7, Hindi news and analysis, Bihar and Jharkhand news, and world affairs from WION, Firstpost and Palki Sharma.
- [Bihar and Jharkhand, all day: news and entertainment](https://ogtv.co.in/for/bihar-jharkhand/): Free Bihar and Jharkhand channels on OGTV: Magadh Times for the region's news, and Purvaiya for live regional news, the legends of Bihar, Chhath, Sharda Sinha, travel and vlogs.
- [A daily feed for India, with nothing to scroll](https://ogtv.co.in/for/daily-feed/): OGTV is a daily feed for India that plays itself: the last two days' trending videos, today's news, cricket highlights, trending songs and markets. Nothing to scroll.
- [Music for India, non-stop and free](https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-music/): Free Indian music, non-stop: Bollywood from the 60s to today, 90s hits, Punjabi, South Indian, classical, bhajans and global hits, as always-on channels.
- [Songs for your mood](https://ogtv.co.in/for/songs-by-mood/): Pick a channel for your mood on OGTV: Select for favourites, Drive for road trips, Gym for workouts, Vibe for parties, Raag for calm, Sadabahar for nostalgia.
- [Sports for India: today's highlights, always on](https://ogtv.co.in/for/indian-sports/): Free sports channels for India: today's cricket highlights (India and the IPL first), football from the Premier League to the ISL, the Olympics, F1 and tennis.
- [Hindi movies, free and always on](https://ogtv.co.in/for/hindi-movies/): Free full Hindi movies on OGTV: classic Hindi films, great films from India and the world, and acclaimed South Indian films in Hindi, always on.
- [Bhajans, all day](https://ogtv.co.in/for/bhajans/): Free bhajans non-stop on OGTV's Bhakti channel: the Mahamrityunjay Mantra at dawn, Hanuman Chalisa, devotional songs and the coming festival's bhajans.
- [Kids' TV, free and always on](https://ogtv.co.in/for/kids/): Bachche on OGTV is a free, always-on children's channel for India: stories, rhymes and early science, with bedtime science and explainers for older kids.
- [Learning that plays on its own](https://ogtv.co.in/for/learning/): Free learning channels for India: space, science and maths explainers, India in maps and data, UPSC and AI and data engineering lectures, money and podcasts.

## 1 · Latest Mix (Latest)

https://ogtv.co.in/latest-mix/ · Latest Mix on OGTV: the last two days' trending videos from every OGTV channel, ranked by how fast they are being watched and updated every hour. They play one after another, and any of them can be picked on the screen, free, with no sign-up.

Good for: What's trending on YouTube in India today; The latest videos from Indian YouTube channels, the last two days; A home page of trending videos, news, cricket, comedy and tech, to pick from.

No schedule: what is trending, the last two days (updated every hour), plays one after another; any can be picked.
